evidence.observation: O2 starts rising from the ~5 ppm post-purge baseline (7.5 ppm)
O2 rises steadily to 39.1 ppm during growth
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm setpoint, so a flow change does not explain the rise
Thermocouple steady at 750 °C with normal heater power
Pressure gauge not installed, so growth-stage atmosphere cannot be verified and a seal leak cannot be told apart from an exhaust blockage

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure reading (a high pressure points to exhaust blockage, a normal one to a seal leak) or a leak check. Characterization of the sample.
